text:
Lena (partnerships): Partner asked: list on CloudMarket + concurrent private offer. They want listing fee waived, clear SKU mapping, and a multi-year renewal step-down. thoughts?
Carlos (marketplace): Fine to combine. Fee waiver should be conditional (e.g., commit >= $300k/yr).
Nina (hw-partner): Need simple SKU rules. Can we publish `embeddings-unit` and `gen-token` and provide a conversion table?
Evan (revops): Keep SKUs separate for AR tracking. Provide a conversion appendix in the private-offer.
Raj (legal): Private-offer must explicitly override public listing prices for the term; include precedence clause and audit right.
Lena (partnerships): Partner also asks for SI co-sell credits (8%). Can we counter?
Evan (revops): 8% is high; propose 6% payable after 3 verified deals or milestone triggers. That keeps economics sane.
Nina (hw-partner): If we get featured listing visibility, we can accept 6% and commit to a higher spend.
Carlos (marketplace): Visibility-for-commit bands: <$250k: standard; $250-500k: featured 60d; >$500k: homepage + co-marketing (2% of commit).
Evan (revops): Also recommend an onboarding escrow credit (10% of Y1 commit) released on usage milestones to smooth revenue.
Raj (legal): Add clawback if reporting/audit failures within 60d. Also cap write-offs at 12% of commit with documented remediation.
Lena (partnerships): Announcement timing: partner wants press at signature. We prefer staged: short "intent" at sign, full case study after 2 customers or 90 days. Include embargo language.
ops-bot: Reminder: file private-offer in #marketplace-deals and attach starter term sheet.
